tables.name: zeiterfassung
tables.create_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zeiterfassung ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, startzeit TEXT NOT NULL, endzeit TEXT, pause INTEGER, beschreibung TEXT DEFAULT '' NULL, standort TEXT DEFAULT '' NULL, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) );

tables.name: Feiertage

tables.name: users
tables.create_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, password TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', token TEXT, department_id INTEGER, supervisor_id INTEGER, regelarbeitszeit REAL DEFAULT 8.0, ueberstunden REAL DEFAULT 0.0, FOREIGN KEY (department_id) REFERENCES departments(id), FOREIGN KEY (supervisor_id) REFERENCES users(id) );

tables.name: departments
tables.create_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS departments ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE );

tables.name: ldap_settings

tables.name: pause_settings

tables.name: login_attempts

tables.name: app_migrations

tables.name: terminal_settings

tables.name: terminal_sites

tables.name: terminals

tables.name: employee_credentials

tables.name: terminal_nonces

tables.name: terminal_limits

tables.name: work_sessions

tables.name: break_intervals

tables.name: attendance_events

tables.name: time_adjustments

triggers.name: initial_work_model
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER initial_work_model AFTER INSERT ON users BEGIN INSERT INTO work_models(user_id,valid_from,minutes_json,reason,created_by,created_at) VALUES(NEW.id,'0001-01-01',json_array(max(0,min(1440,round(NEW.regelarbeitszeit*60))),max(0,min(1440,round(NEW.regelarbeitszeit*60))),max(0,min(1440,round(NEW.regelarbeitszeit*60))),max(0,min(1440,round(NEW.regelarbeitszeit*60))),max(0,min(1440,round(NEW.regelarbeitszeit*60))),0,0),'Startmodell aus Tages-Soll',0,unixepoch()); END

relationship_exceptions: work_models.created_by=0 is the documented system actor; audit_log user_id=0 can denote shared Feiertage.
Approved cancellation retains original work_sessions/time_adjustments record_id after zeiterfassung deletion; require matching approved cancel and audit evidence rather than recreate projection.
audit_log.entity/record_id is polymorphic historical identity, never a live foreign-key assertion.

connection_contract.foreign_keys: legacy does not configure; inspect effective value, do not silently adopt Laravel default
connection_contract.udf_registration: Pdo\Sqlite::createFunction on PHP8.5 before migration/write; reconnect registration mandatory
